text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prosecutors, seeking to reopen murder charges against former president Kamuzu Banda for the 1993 murder of three cabinet ministers and a member of parliament, have dropped charges against one of the accused. The case against the man was destroyed by the death of two of the six original defendants after their acquittal in 1995.
- Labour Minister Kaliyoma Phumisa criticised the government's cumbersome process for issuing temporary employment permits to expatriates, saying it had earned Malawi "a bad name".
